name: S.A. Commerciale de Brasserie Co.Br.Ha
summary: S.A. Commerciale de Brasserie Co.Br.Ha operates as a beer brewery primarily in Belgium. The company offers beers, lemonades and water, wines, and coffees. It operates under the Charles Quint, Mystic, SUPER 8, Tongerlo, Adler, Blonde, EUPENER BIER, Gildenbier, Maltosa, Primus, Speciale 1900, Star Blond, VAL, Fuerto, and CASTLE WINES brand names. The company was founded in 1893 and is based in Boortmeerbeek, Belgium. S.A. Commerciale de Brasserie Co.Br.Ha is a subsidiary of Finabra SA.
